rows.title: Film Review: Samurai Rebellion (1967) by Masaki Kobayashi
rows.comment: The movie tells a tragic and compelling story that becomes more suspenseful as it continues
rows.verdict_le10: The movie tells a tragic and compelling story that becomes more suspenseful as it continues
rows.dek_lead: The movie tells a tragic and compelling story that becomes more suspenseful as it continues. The acting from the entire cast is top-notch, featuring one of Toshiro Mifune’s most memorable performances of his acting career.
